checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: One ~10 s landscape video with music embedded
must.why: The final mp4 was not provided. The agent reports 854x480, 10.2 s with music. The clips I have total 7 s, and the audio file is 15 s.

must.item: Visibly includes neon signs, a moving train and wet street reflections at night
must.why: The train clip and the wet neon street clip are clearly present. The neon signs clip claimed for 0-3 s was not among the clips I could see. Only incidental building signs appear in the train shot.

must.item: Upbeat electronic instrumental audible across the montage, no speech or singing
must.why: The audio has sound at a -1 dB peak, but I cannot hear it. The audio is 15 s, not 10 s.

must.item: At least two shot changes coincide with audible beats
must.why: The agent admits it did not verify beat alignment. The cut points are unknown.

must.item: No added titles, captions or subtitles
must.why: No overlay text appears in the frames. Only incidental building signage is visible.

faults.what: No neon-signs clip appears in the provided clips, so one of the three requested subjects may be missing or unverified.
The train clip is 4 s and the street clip is 3 s, which does not match the claimed 0-3 / 3-7 / 7-10 s structure.
The train looks pink and slightly smeared, with indistinct figures in the windows. The train shot fades to an empty track by 3.8 s.
The audio is 15 s against a ~10 s film, and the agent never checked beat alignment.

summary: The train and wet neon street clips look good and cinematic, but the neon signs clip is not evidenced, and the final cut, music and beat sync are unverified.
